nodes.label: Pixel-density image variants (@1x/@2x/@3x)
nodes.rationale: React Native resolves @2x/@3x suffixed assets automatically based on device pixel ratio, so the same logo is shipped at three resolutions for crisp rendering on high-DPI screens.

nodes.label: Development build (required for native modules)
nodes.rationale: Expo Go only bundles its own native modules, so libraries with native code need expo run or eas build --profile development.

nodes.label: EAS (build, submit, update)
nodes.rationale: Cloud build/sign/submit and OTA updates without local Xcode or Android Studio.

nodes.label: npx expo install (SDK-compatible dependency install)
nodes.rationale: Always used instead of npm/yarn/pnpm/bun add because it resolves SDK-compatible versions.

nodes.label: Expo Router (routes in src/app/)
nodes.rationale: Every file in src/app/ is a screen, _layout.tsx defines navigators; non-route code kept outside src/app/.

nodes.label: npm run reset-project (moves starter to app-example)
nodes.norm_label: npm run reset-project (moves starter to app-example)

nodes.label: Continuous Native Generation (no hand-edited ios/android)
nodes.rationale: ios/ and android/ are generated; configure native behavior through app.json and config plugins.

nodes.label: Lint + typecheck before done (expo lint, tsc --noEmit)
nodes.norm_label: lint + typecheck before done (expo lint, tsc --noemit)

nodes.label: Prefer recommended Expo modules over third-party libs
nodes.norm_label: prefer recommended expo modules over third-party libs

nodes.label: Use versioned Expo docs, not training data
nodes.norm_label: use versioned expo docs, not training data
nodes.rationale: Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release; APIs are renamed/moved/removed, so read expo major version from package.json and fetch matching docs or llms.txt.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon (layered foreground/background/monochrome)
nodes.rationale: Android launchers compose separate foreground and background layers and use a monochrome layer for themed icons, so the icon is split into three files.

nodes.label: Expo Chevron Logo Mark
nodes.rationale: All app icon assets use the default create-expo-app chevron branding; the receipts-scanner app has not yet been given custom branding.
